pluginDirectory.search: Filters by visible app name, category and description
pluginDirectory.plus: Adds/removes the matching entry in local browser state; it does not connect the external provider
pluginDirectory.googleDrive: Shows lock indicator; tap opens an unverified lock explanation
pluginDirectory.installed: Shows the apps added to the local demo

implementationLimits: Provider authentication and live API calls are not implemented.
Uploaded files retain local filenames only; binary uploads are not sent to a server.
Pin and lock are local UI states; lock does not invoke Android security.
Share uses Web Share when available and otherwise explains the offline limitation.
Speech playback uses browser speech synthesis when available.
